needed.evidence: Footway is less than 1m wide and partly blocked with obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install a dedicated sidewalk at least 1.5m wide along the left side of the road.

needed.evidence: Footway obstructed by parked vehicles or other objects
needed.suggestion: Implement appropriate parking regulations and install clear fences/bollards to keep footway clear of obstructions.

needed.evidence: Uneven and potentially hazardous surface on the narrow footway
needed.suggestion: Pave and level the uneven sections of the footway to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Crossing demand is high but crossing infrastructure is only a marked crossing with poor quality
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised crossing with a refuge island to enhance the safety of pedestrians crossing this road.

needed.evidence: Marked crossing is poorly visible and potentially unsafe for pedestrians
needed.suggestion: Install reflective markings and signs to make the pedestrian crossing more visible to drivers.

needed.evidence: No raised kerbs at the crossing for smooth pedestrian access
needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at the pedestrian crossing to facilitate easier and safer crossing for pedestrians.
